app "Tailor" pen plum
table client name text, phone text?
table order client ref client, item text, due date, ready bool, price money?
table batch order ref order, what text, cost money
"Balance to pay" sum(order.price where ready = no) - sum(batch.cost) big
each client as c
  let owes = count(c.order where ready = no) - sum(c.order.price where ready = no)
  row card tap edit c
    c.name bold grow
    owes bold color if(owes > 0, bad, good)
form client, "Add client"
form order, "New order"
form batch, "Add batch"
list batch
form client, "Add client"
form order, "New order"

app "Bee Yard" bolt plum
table hive name text
table inspect hive ref hive, queen_seen bool, brood num 0..10 = 0, note text?
each hive sort name as h
  stack card gap 1
    row
      h.name head grow
      count(h.inspect) "of" h.name faint
    "Last seen" last(h.inspect.at) faint
    row gap 1
      each h.inspect sort at desc top 3 as i
        button "Wore one" tap add inspect hive = h, at = i.at
      button "Question" tap set h.at = if(h.at = index, "Right", "Question")
form hive, "Add hive"
form inspect, "Log inspection"

app "Qaza" mosque ocean
table qaza part pick Morning|Evening|Night = Morning
setting target num = 1200 "Count to"
let n = count(qaza today)
draw width 240 tap add qaza part = target, at = if(n % target = 0, Morning, "Fajr missed: turn it up")
  circle 44 stroke soft thick 8
  arc 44, 0, 360 * (n % target) / target stroke accent thick 8
  label 50, 46, n % target big
  label 50, 64, "Round" floor(n / target) + 1 faint
when n > 0 and n % target = 0 notify "Round complete"

app "Net sessions" ball ocean
table session net_date date, bowler text, runs num 0..200, wickets num 0..10
"Next" count(session where net_date >= today) "sessions to go" head
daybars last 7 days, sum(session.wickets on it)
form session, "Log session"
list session by day

app "Insulin" pill plum
table dose units num 1..80, kind pick Fast|Long_acting|Bedtime = Fast
setting gap num = 60 "Hours between doses"
let given = sum(dose.units today)
goal given, max(dose.units today), gap, "doses given today"
"Blocking now" count(dose where kind = Fast) "fasts" faint
each dose where kind = Fast sort units as d
  row card tap edit d
    d.units bold
    stack grow
      d.kind bold
      "Last dose" d.at faint
    button "Next dose" tap set gap = max(gap, 1)
form dose, "Add dose"

app "Bike service" bike ink
table service what text, km num 0..2000000, cost money, next date?
screen main "Add" plus
  form service
screen charts "Charts" chart
  list service

app "Udhaar" wallet slate
table customer name text, phone text?
table udhaar customer ref customer, amount money, paid date = today, due date
"Total due" sum(udhaar.amount where paid = no) big
each customer sort name as c
  let owed = sum(c.udhaar.amount where paid = no)
  row card gap 1 tap edit c
    c.name bold grow
    owed bold color if(owed > 0, bad, good)
" Each pays" head
each customer sort name as c
  let owed = sum(c.udhaar.amount where paid = no)
  row card gap 1
    c.name grow
    "gets" round(owed * 0.9) big
    button "Paid" tap add udhaar customer = c, amount = 20
form customer, "Add customer"
form udhaar, "Add entry"

app " Loft" paw slate
table bird ring text, colour text?, pair text?, eggs num 0..20000
table nest bird ref bird, eggs num 1..2000
each bird sort ring as b
  row card tap edit b
    b.ring bold
    b.colour grow
    if(sum(b.nest.eggs) >= b.eggs, "Eggs in", "Eggs") "mate" faint
    b.eggs "eggs" bold
form bird, "Add bird"
form nest, "Add nest"

app "Kite Stock" star plum
table kite_item name text, price money, size pick Mon|Dwar|Manjha = Mon, qty num 0..
table kite_deal kite_item ref kite_item, buyer text, sold money
each kite_item sort name as k
  let low = k.qty - sum(k.kite_deal.sold)
  row card tap edit k
    k.name bold grow
    k.size faint
    low bold color if(low > 20, bad, ink)
"Sales this month" sum(kite_deal month, it.sold * it.buyer) big
form kite_deal, "New deal"
form kite_item, "Add item"
